entities.name: Andreas Henrisusanta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Andreas Henrisusanta, S.C.I. was an Indonesian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as bishop 
of the Diocese of Tanjungkarang, Indonesia from 1979 to 2012.
